title: Maximize Expression of Three Elements
summary: Given an integer array, select three distinct elements to maximize the expression a + b - c.
statement: Given an integer array, select three distinct elements to maximize the expression a + b - c. Return the highest achievable value of this expression.
constraints: Choose three distinct array indices assigned to a, b, and c.
hints: The two positive terms should use the two largest occurrences.
The subtracted term should use the smallest remaining occurrence.
Sorting exposes these three positions while respecting duplicate multiplicity.
Any exchange toward larger positive or smaller negative terms cannot reduce the expression.
editorial: Any exchange toward larger positive or smaller negative terms cannot reduce the expression.

tests.explanation: Choose five and four as positive terms and one as c, giving eight.
Use negative two and negative three, then subtract negative five, giving zero.
